chunks: Muhammad ibn Ahmad ibn Ibrahim al-Mu'adhi narrated to us. He said: Abu Abdillah Muhammad ibn Abdillah ibn al-Faraj al-Sharuti narrated to us. He said: Abu Abdillah Muhammad ibn Yazid ibn al-Muhallab narrated to us. He said: Abu Usama narrated to us. He said: Awf narrated to me, from Maymun. He said: al-Bara' ibn Azib informed me. He said:

When the Messenger of God (may God bless him and his family) ordered for the trench to be dug, a great and hard boulder appeared across the trench that the pickaxes could not break. So the Messenger of God (may God bless him and his family) came, and when he saw it, he took off his robe and picked up the pickaxe, and said: "In the name of God," and struck it once, breaking off a third of it. He said: "God is the Greatest! I have been given the keys to the Levant. By God, I can see its red palaces at this very moment."

Then he struck it a second time and said: "In the name of God," and split off another third. He said: "God is the Greatest! I have been given the keys to Persia. By God, I can see the white palace of al-Mada'in."
Then he struck it a third time and split the remainder of the boulder. He said: "God is the Greatest! I have been given the keys to Yemen. By God, I can see the gates of Sanaa from my place here."

key_terms.الخندق: The Trench (Khandaq) - a defensive ditch dug around Medina in 5 AH
key_terms.المدائن: Al-Mada'in (Ctesiphon) - the Sasanian capital near modern Baghdad
key_terms.المعاول: Pickaxes used for digging and breaking rock
key_terms.صنعاء: Sanaa - the capital city of Yemen
key_terms.مفاتيح: Keys - metaphor for divine grant of dominion and conquest

ai.seo_question: What did Prophet Muhammad prophesy when breaking the boulder during the Battle of the Trench?
ai.summary: This hadith narrates an event during the Battle of the Trench (Khandaq) in 5 AH, when the Muslims were digging a defensive trench around Medina against the confederate armies. When an immovable boulder blocked the digging, Prophet Muhammad (SAWW) personally struck it three times, each time prophesying the future Muslim conquest of a major region: the Levant (Syria), Persia, and Yemen. These prophecies were fulfilled within decades of the Prophet's lifetime, affirming his truthfulness and divine support.

en.bilal-muhammad: Muhammad b. Ahmad b. Ibrahim al-Mu`adhi narrated to us. He said: Abu `Abdillah Muhammad b. `Abdullah b. al-Faraj al-Sharuti narrated to us. He said: Abu `Abdillah Muhammad b. Yazid b. al-Muhallab. He said: Abu Aslama narrated to us. He said: `Awf narrated to me from Maymun. He said: al-Bara’ b. `Azib informed me. He said:

When the Messenger of Allah (s) ordered for the trench (al-khandaq) to be dug, a great boulder appeared across the trench that could not be broken with a pickaxe. So, the Messenger of Allah (s) came, and when he saw it, he took off his robe, picked up the pickaxe, and said: “In the name of Allah” and struck it once. He broke off a third of it. He said: “Allah is the Greatest. I have been given the keys to the Levant. By Allah, I see its red palaces at this moment.”

Then, he struck it a second time and said: “In the name of Allah” and another third of it split off. So, he said: “Allah is the Greatest. I have been given the keys to Persia. By Allah, I see the white palaces of al-Mada’in.”

Then, he struck it a third time, and the remainder of the boulder came apart. He said: “Allah is the Greatest. I have been given the keys to Yemen. By Allah, I see the gates of Sanaa from my place here.”
